pairs.question: Quomodo haec fiant?
pairs.answer: Interroga gratiam, non doctrinam; desiderium, non intellectum; gemitum orationis, non studium lectionis; sponsum, non magistrum; Deum, non hominem: caliginem, non claritatem; non lucem, sed ignem totaliter inflammantem et in Deum excessivis unctionibus et ardentissimis affectionibus transferentem.
pairs.derivation: Authorial-rhetorical: author poses the question and answers it himself. Question is the operative interrogative of 'Si autem quaeras, quomodo haec fiant'; the asking-frame 'Si autem quaeras' is dropped as narration of the questioning, leaving the utterance 'quomodo haec fiant' (normalized capitalization and '?'). Answer begins at the operative reply 'interroga gratiam...' and runs as one contiguous sentence to the first full stop at '...transferentem.' (the colons/semicolons within are not sentence ends; the stray period after 'caliginem' is a conversion artifact and is normalized to a comma). No '...' ellipsis; all words are the author's own and contiguous.
